greeting: Hey, explorer. I'm Orbit, your local scripted guide. Ask about a character, a world, trailers, events, releases, shopping, or how this site works.
fallback: I don’t have a verified answer for that in this collection. Try a character or event name, choose a world, or search the archive. I don’t generate facts or use a live AI service.

faqs.answer: Bookmark buttons save collection IDs in this browser's localStorage. Open Saved to review, remove, or export them.
Personal notes use sessionStorage. They last for this tab session and are not written into the bundled JSON files.
Open Saved and choose Export readable list. The text file includes saved entries, sources, and session notes.
The cart is a temporary demonstration. FandomVerse has no checkout, payment, stock guarantee, or order processing. Follow each product's official retailer link to purchase there.
The demo cart calculates quantities and a USD total from the listed prices. It does not add tax or shipping and resets when the page session ends.
Each merchandise page shows its currency, listed variant price, retailer link, and verification date. Retailer prices can change.
Login and signup are interface demonstrations. They do not authenticate visitors or store passwords.
Use Search from the header on every route. Combine a phrase with category and content-type filters. World hubs add sub-tags and alphabetical, newest, or featured sorting.
FandomVerse covers Anime, Gaming, Movies, TV Shows, K-Pop, Comics, and Manga. Every world has a hub with profiles, articles, events, and a gallery.
FandomVerse is an independent competition project. It is not affiliated with featured rights holders, artists, or retailers.
The Credits page explains the media policy, and each sourced image links to its creator and license. Fan cosplay is labeled as fan cosplay rather than official character art.

Character, event, and trailer cards use licensed or official subject visuals where verified. Exact product photography remains on the official retailer sites because republication permission has not been established.
The site and local licensed media can load from the build. External official trailers, retailers, sources, and Google Maps need an internet connection.
Media pages include captions or an accessible description where available. Players start only after you open them; controls are keyboard accessible.
Historical events are labeled past and kept as archive records. Release dates and event details link to sources rather than being guessed.
The calendar includes sourced announcements. Unknown dates remain unannounced; the site does not turn rumors into confirmed releases.
The visitor counter is a localStorage demonstration on this browser. It is not a real global audience metric.
Contact shows the team’s public map location in DHA, Karachi. You can request your own location through the browser; denial and unavailable states are explained without saving your coordinates.

Warriors Xtreme created this independent competition project. The team members listed on About are Hassan Jahangir, Hassan Khan, Hassan Afridi, Shayan, Shahnoor, and Gufran. Contact uses hassanssk21@gmail.com and a DHA Karachi map.
I'm a local scripted assistant. I match your question to sourced collection records and predefined FAQs. I have no live AI, internet lookup, or account access.
The Anime world also features official Naruto, Attack on Titan, JUJUTSU KAISEN, and My Hero Academia video previews. They are historical or current entries as labeled, not invented artwork.
Warriors Xtreme is the student team behind this independent competition project. The About page lists Hassan Jahangir, Hassan Khan, Hassan Afridi, Shayan, Shahnoor, and Gufran.
The Demon Slayer sixth-anniversary celebration is a sourced past event. Open its record for the exact date and official announcement.
Anime Expo 2025 is recorded as a past Los Angeles event. Its card uses a photograph taken at the 2025 convention.
San Diego Comic-Con 2025 is a past event in this archive. The event page includes its source and a licensed photograph from the convention.
Lucasfilm announced Ahsoka season 2 for January 20, 2027 on Disney+. The date was verified from StarWars.com on September 26, 2026 and may change.
Marvel Entertainment published an official Avengers: Doomsday trailer in July 2026. The trailer player loads from YouTube only when opened, and the release entry links to the confirmed date.
Nintendo’s Super Mario Bros. Wonder launch trailer shows Wonder Flowers and transformations. The game’s release, article, and official trailer each have their own sourced record.
Jin’s The Astronaut was released in 2022. Its official HYBE LABELS music video loads through an online player; no song file is hosted here.
Every bundled image has a source, creator, and license in Media Credits. Fan cosplay is labeled so it is not confused with official franchise artwork.
Notes are kept only in this tab’s sessionStorage. Closing the tab ends the session; no backend receives them.
The configured public team location is DHA Karachi. The map opens from Contact and needs an internet connection.
